paper_id: SateLight_ A Satellite Application Update Framework for Satellite Computing
title: SateLight: A Satellite Application Update Framework for Satellite Computing
motivation: 卫星应用需远程更新但面临异构性、带宽受限、空间环境恶劣三大挑战，现有地面方案不适用
problem_framing: 设计统一框架应对卫星应用更新，需兼顾异构性封装、带宽高效传输、故障可靠恢复
key_insight: 用容器化统一异构应用，内容感知差分编码传输，层级回滚实现故障恢复
method_signature: 容器化+内容感知差分+层级回滚的卫星应用更新框架
evaluation_criteria: 传输延迟、更新延迟、正确性、恢复开销
negative_result_or_admitted_limitation: 层回滚需额外存储空间，与补丁恢复相比存储开销更大
evidence_for_taste: sidesteps this complexity through application containerization
balances semantic accuracy with computational efficiency
ensures deterministic reconstruction during the subsequent onboard update
instead of relying on fine-grained state reconstruction
offers a balanced trade-off between recovery overhead and storage overhead
these limitations preclude the use of heavyweight software update methods
thinking_moves: 用容器化抽象规避异构工具链复杂性问题
混合差分策略平衡语义精度与计算效率
利用容器固有层级结构实现零重传回滚
确定性重构确保更新正确性
权衡恢复延迟与存储开销
